nodes.label: icon-192.png (Boxy PWA icon 192x192)
nodes.description: Square app icon: solid green background (matches manifest theme_color #16a34a) with a large bold white sans-serif letter 'B' centered. Declared as the 192x192 PWA manifest icon used for install / home-screen shortcuts.

nodes.label: Boxy brand mark (white B on green)
nodes.rationale: Minimal monogram of the visible product brand 'Boxy' (not the internal 'crotone' name); flat green tile keeps it legible at small sizes and consistent with the PWA theme_color #16a34a.
